Danish Composers

Maria Ahlefeldt Carl Andersen
Ida da Fonseca Peter Müller

Maria Theresia Ahlefeldt (16
January 1755 – 20 December 1810)
was a Danish, (originally
German), composer. She is known
as the first female composer in
Denmark. Maria Theresia composed
music for several ballets,
operas, and plays of the royal
theatre. She was given good
critic as a composer and
described as a “virkelig
Tonekunstnerinde” ('a True
Artist of Music').
